title: Scenic Anchorage to Girdwood Tour with Local Delicacies
includes: 3.5-hour scenic trip from Anchorage to Girdwood
requirements: Infants and small children can ride in a pram or stroller
Infants are required to sit on an adult’s lap
Suitable for all physical fitness levels
cancellation: For a full refund, cancel at least 24 hours before the scheduled departure time.
blurb:
Discover the beauty of Alaska on this 3.5-hour scenic trip from Anchorage to Girdwood. Capture stunning views at Beluga Point, where the majestic Cook Inlet meets the mountains, and stop by Indian Valley Meats to explore unique Alaskan specialties. Once in Girdwood, enjoy leisure time to soak in the charm of this mountain town before returning. This tour offers a relaxed atmosphere with insights from a knowledgeable local host with 24 years of Alaskan experience.

- Scenic 3.5-hour trip from Anchorage to Girdwood
- Photograph the breathtaking views at Beluga Point
- Visit Indian Valley Meats for distinctive Alaskan delicacies
- Explore the charming mountain town of Girdwood at your own pace
